annotations.title: Request a Software Project Scoping Call

description: For anyone who wants an app or software built, or a failing app or agency project rescued, by Ruzora's Software Factory (fixed price, milestones). Checks fit (budget, timing) and returns a scoping-call booking link when it fits. Sends the name, email and company given to Ruzora.

budget.description: Budget: under $15K, $15-50K, $50-150K, over $150K, or not sure

buyer_token.description: Proof the user verified this work email: the buyer_token from confirm_work_email (valid 7 days). No token yet? Call verify_work_email first.

kind.description: "build" = new app or software; "rescue" = fix or take over a failing app or agency project

project_summary.description: One paragraph: what to build or what is broken (shown back to help you prepare the call)

your_title.description: The asker's own position: founder_ceo, cto_vp_eng, eng_manager, hr_ops_finance or other
